name: Ginger Snaps
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: flour to commence with
ingredients.originalText: three pints flour to commence with

instructions.text: Rub shortening and sugar together into the flour
Add enough more flour to roll very smooth and very thin
Bake in a quick oven without burning
The dough can be kept for days by putting it in the flour barrel under the flour, and bake a few at a time
They should become perfectly cold before putting aside

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Rub shortening and sugar together into the flour
2. Add enough more flour to roll very smooth and very thin
3. Roll out to wafer-like thinness
4. Bake in a quick oven without burning
5. The dough can be kept for days by putting it in the flour barrel under the flour, and bake a few at a time
6. They should become perfectly cold before putting aside
